verdict.rationale: Meilisearch documents typed official SDKs for JavaScript, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, Rust, Java, Swift, Dart and .NET. It also has dedicated pages for the official JS/TypeScript and async Python clients, plus first-party Laravel Scout, Rails and React InstantSearch integrations. The "kept current" part is weaker: hands-on reports say the Rails gem fell out of step with the server and the .NET client was still alpha at 1.0, though these reports are dated. Missing for 10: documented SDK versioning/compatibility policy, evidence that all SDKs track server releases, and dedicated docs for the Go/PHP/Ruby and other SDKs.
